im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
red = (R>90)&(R-G>30)&(R-B>30)
blue = (B-R>25)&(B-G>15)&(B>80)
# ASCII map: each cell 4x4
H,W=R.shape
for y in range(0,H,4):
    row=''
    for x in range(0,W,4):
        r=red[y:y+4,x:x+4].mean(); b=blue[y:y+4,x:x+4].mean()
        if r>0.4: row+='R'
        elif b>0.4: row+='B'
        elif r>0.1: row+='r'
        elif b>0.1: row+='b'
        else: row+='.'
    print(row)
\"

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
for name,mask in [('RED',(R>90)&(R-G>30)&(R-B>30)),('BLUE',(B-R>25)&(B-G>15)&(B>80))]:
    lab,n=ndi.label(mask)
    print(name,'components',n)
    sizes=ndi.sum(mask,lab,range(1,n+1))
    for i in np.argsort(-sizes)[:8]:
        cid=i+1
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==cid)
        print(' id',cid,'size',int(sizes[i]),'bbox x',xs.min(),xs.max(),'y',ys.min(),ys.max(),'meanRGB',im[lab==cid].mean(0).round(1))
\"
"
